elements.el: Read the state and follow its specific next step: enable an enrolled gateway, start a native shell, use the existing browser window, sign in again or inspect the host.
Phone and no-JavaScript states keep the native terminal/copy route. A stale public id or replayed authorization requires a fresh launch.
Session loss, idle timeout, connection loss and sandbox exit disconnect the browser and clear its terminal buffer. What was typed is not recorded.

fixture: The pictured account, host, id and terminal text are illustrative. Behavior is tested against the actual gateway/controller and console broker.
